name: mixed-worth
formatting: Missing space after the comma in the import

findings.title: Missing space after the comma in the import
findings.description: `RateLimited,TransientError` has no space after the comma. Write `RateLimited, TransientError`, as PEP 8 asks.

findings.title: The last failed attempt still sleeps before giving up
findings.description: After the fifth `TransientError` the loop sleeps for the full backoff, about 3.2 seconds, and only then reaches the `raise` on line 20. No retry follows that sleep, so every call that gives up is delayed for nothing. Skip the sleep on the last attempt.

findings.title: The docstring says the function returns None, but it raises
findings.description: The docstring says `fetch_with_retry` returns None when every attempt fails. Line 20 raises `TransientError` instead. A caller that trusts the docstring checks for None and never catches the error.

findings.title: No test runs the `RateLimited` branch
findings.description: Both new tests in `tests/test_retry.py` raise only `TransientError`. Nothing runs the `RateLimited` branch on lines 15 and 16, so a change to how `retry_after` is read breaks rate-limited calls with no failing test. Add a test whose session raises `RateLimited` once.

checks: Read `tests/test_retry.py`: `FlakySession.get` raises only `TransientError`, and neither test uses another session

+import random
+import time
+
+from billing.errors import RateLimited,TransientError
+
+MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5
+
+
+def fetch_with_retry(session, url, timeout=2.0):
+    """Fetch url. Returns None when every attempt fails."""
+    wait = 0.2
+    for _ in range(MAX_ATTEMPTS):
+        try:
+            return session.get(url, timeout=timeout)
+        except RateLimited as err:
+            time.sleep(err.retry_after)
+        except TransientError:
+            time.sleep(wait + random.random() * 0.1)
+            wait *= 2
+    raise TransientError(f"gave up on {url} after {MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts")

@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import pytest
+
+from billing.errors import TransientError
+from billing.retry import MAX_ATTEMPTS, fetch_with_retry
+
+
+class FlakySession:
+    def __init__(self, failures):
+        self.failures = failures
+        self.calls = 0
+
+    def get(self, url, timeout):
+        self.calls += 1
+        if self.calls <= self.failures:
+            raise TransientError("boom")
+        return "ok"
+
+
+def test_retries_transient_errors(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr("time.sleep", lambda _: None)
+    session = FlakySession(failures=2)
+    assert fetch_with_retry(session, "/invoices") == "ok"
+    assert session.calls == 3
+
+
+def test_gives_up_after_max_attempts(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr("time.sleep", lambda _: None)
+    session = FlakySession(failures=MAX_ATTEMPTS)
+    with pytest.raises(TransientError):
+        fetch_with_retry(session, "/invoices")
